policies.summary: No technique may be adopted or adapted without a lineage record and registry entry.
policies.rationale: Silent assimilation hides provenance and blocks audit of borrowed practice.

policies.summary: METHOD.md must mention T-XXX for every adopted, adapted, or originated-here technique.
policies.rationale: The living paper is the human-readable seal surface; ids keep it checkable.

policies.summary: CI and scripts validate structure and consistency only; humans own scientific decisions.
policies.rationale: Conflating green builds with truth recreates status inflation in tooling form.

policies.summary: PRs that change method surface or lineage must pass admit.py / pytest.
policies.rationale: Admission is a controlled gate; skipping it defeats the ledger.

policies.summary: This repository excludes domain ontology and programme-specific experimental claims.
policies.rationale: Portability requires a clean method boundary.

policies.summary: Consuming programmes pin sealed releases under releases/, not arbitrary living tips.
policies.rationale: Pins must be reproducible and intentional.
